rules: Before changing anything under `kicad/`, run `./run --native tools/kicad_ipc.py status`. `closed`: file-level edits are allowed. `other`: stop and ask the user. `ipc`: board edits go only through `tools/kicad_ipc.py` (IPC), as one undoable commit, never saving, and only while the Schematic Editor is closed (the tool refuses otherwise; KiCad 10 freezes); the user reviews in the GUI and saves. Schematic edits are never live on KiCad 10 (no schematic API until KiCad 11). (Amended after the fnd-06 live trial; see `docs/kicad-ipc.md`.)
Never write `kicad/*.kicad_sch` or `kicad/*.kicad_pcb` directly while KiCad has the project open.

If an edit is needed that IPC cannot do while the project is open (any schematic change, or a board edit while the user needs the Schematic Editor open), stop and ask the user to close KiCad, or just the Schematic Editor; after the edit, ask them to reopen it.

Batch operations (ERC, DRC, exports, report builds) use `kicad-cli` through `./run`. Analyses read the files headless so reports rebuild without the GUI. When the project is open, use `tools/kicad_ipc.py show` to select what is being discussed so the user can follow along.
Never read `.env` into output, print its values, or commit it; tools read keys from it at run time only.
Never regenerate or modify `production/` in place; new fab outputs go to new paths and are recorded with `friday result write --file`.

Electrical design decisions (part and footprint choice, routing, placement, ordering, sending to a fab) are the user's: prepare options and evidence, do not decide or apply them unless a directive states the decided change.
Never Verify on an exact DRC warning count: `solder_mask_bridge` jitters by +/-1 on identical input.

An analysis write-up source is `analysis/NN_name/writeup.md`, never `report.md` or another report-named file: Claude Code refuses to let subagents write report files. Built outputs stay `reports/NN_name.pdf` and `.pptx`.
